# SinShield

> SinShield is a free, private adult-content blocker for Android. It analyzes supported app screens on the device and can block known adult websites through local DNS filtering, without requiring an account or uploading browsing activity to SinShield.

## Product

- [SinShield home](https://sinshield.app/): Overview of SinShield, how its on-device protection works, supported content surfaces, privacy model, and frequently asked questions.
- [Products](https://sinshield.app/products): Product availability and ways to get started.
- [SinShield for Android](https://sinshield.app/products/android): Android requirements, setup steps, permissions, protection features, and current availability.

## About and editorial trust

- [About SinShield](https://sinshield.app/about): Why SinShield exists, how its private protection works, its limitations, and contact information.
- [Editorial standards](https://sinshield.app/editorial-standards): Research, review, disclosure, update, and corrections policy for SinShield articles.
- [SinShield Editorial](https://sinshield.app/authors/sinshield-editorial): Author and reviewer profile for the team that maintains the SinShield blog.

## Guides and research

- [SinShield blog](https://sinshield.app/blog): All SinShield articles about digital habits, adult-content blocking, and recovery.
- [Porn on X: Is It Allowed and How Do You Block It?](https://sinshield.app/blog/porn-on-x): X's adult-content rules, sensitive-content controls, and practical blocking options.
- [Benefits of Quitting Porn: 8 Realistic Changes You May Notice](https://sinshield.app/blog/benefits-of-quitting-porn): An evidence-aware guide to possible benefits and realistic expectations.
- [Countries Where Porn Is Illegal: What the Law Actually Bans](https://sinshield.app/blog/countries-where-porn-is-illegal): A guide to differences among viewing, possession, import, production, distribution, and website blocking laws.
- [Does Porn Lower Your IQ? What the Research Actually Shows](https://sinshield.app/blog/does-porn-lower-your-iq): A research-based explanation of IQ, attention, working memory, sleep, and problematic use.
- [The 9 Best Accountability Apps to Quit Porn in 2026](https://sinshield.app/blog/best-accountability-apps-to-quit-porn): A comparison of accountability and adult-content-blocking apps.
- [How to Break the Scroll-Trigger Loop Before It Takes Over](https://sinshield.app/blog/how-to-break-the-scroll-trigger-loop): Practical steps for recognizing triggers and interrupting unwanted scrolling habits.
